The plate measures about 360 px across, which I take as roughly 26 cm. The food covers about 160 × 130 px, or about 11 × 9 cm. It looks like orange, sweet-potato-style food with some red cabbage, piled fairly thick at perhaps 2–3 cm. That gives about 100 cm² of footprint, so a volume near 200 cm³ and a mass near 150 g after allowing for air gaps. At roughly 1.5 kcal/g for roasted sweet potato with oil, the energy comes to about 220 kcal.
